text: Sydney Seals Freediving Club is not-for-profit and volunteer run, to support the development and growth of freedivers in Sydney Australia and surrounding regions. We are an affiliated Club of the Australian Freediving Association (AFA) established in early 2025, Sydney Australia (Eora).

text: We run both pool and depth training sessions, so you can progress all disciplines, improve breathhold, and underwater skills in a safe setting. Certified beginners and all levels are welcome.

Pool training is located in Marrickville and Randwick on weekdays. Depth training runs in collaboration with a skilled and fully licensed commercial boat operator, on weekends when we have sufficient demand. We can find up to 100m depth a short boat ride past Sydney Harbour Heads.

The fee paid to the club cover the cost of pool lane hire and pool entry (with an exception at Marrickville where you pay pool entry separately), or boat charter in the case of depth training, where the fee depends on the number of participants for every session.
Freediving businesses (schools) interested in sharing boat charter can contact us on sydneysealsfc@gmail.com to discuss opportuinities for collaboration.
Become a member and then contact us to express your interest to join pool training. If you're already a member, book training below or on the app.

join.intro: Membership covers one year with Sydney Seals and the AFA, which you need to compete in any AFA freediving competition in Australia and participate in club activities.
join.outro: As a not-for-profit, all fees to the club go back into our objectives – that is, facilitating freediving!
